_comment: O1 oracle-reachability gate v1.5. Fill every remaining FREEZE_SLOT, create CALIBRATION_PRECOMMIT.json before calibration generation, run executable calibration, build deterministic seed matrix and RUN_PROVENANCE.json, then create PREGENERATION_SEAL.json before the confirmatory records file exists.
_manifest_hash_note: The manifest cannot carry its own hash. After every slot is filled, hash this file and record the digest in an external SEAL.json / SHA256SUMS. Gate G0 rejects a manifest containing a manifest_sha256 key.

code.fixture_suite_result: 53/53 core; 17/17 calibration; 13/13 v1.5.3 integration; 7/7 CLI workflow; axis verifier 15/15

generator.task_id_hash_scheme: sha256(canonical UTF-8 JSON task specification, sorted keys, no whitespace)

difficulty_strata.selection_rule: generator-level estimates from the calibration cohort only; never realized confirmatory outcomes
difficulty_strata.noninferiority_basis: lower one-sided 95% confidence bound, not the point estimate

decoding.stopping_rule: stop after the first parseable FINAL ANSWER commitment or at max_new_tokens; parser hash sealed

writable_boundary.delta_broadcast_rule: Per branch, add delta only at the final non-padding prompt position at the L3_24 post-layer residual boundary. d has unit RMS over the hidden dimension; r is the pre-intervention per-position residual RMS; delta = sign * alpha * r * d. All other positions receive zero. Not repeated on generated tokens or at later loop/layer visits.
writable_boundary.status: INSTRUMENT CHOICE, not a claim that L3_24 is the optimal control locus. A negative result is scoped to this boundary and action family.

boundary_validated_by: V4 loop-targeted current-token perturbation validated at physical layers 24/36/47
suffix-recompute splice v2 validated at zero-based loop 2, layer 24
first affected cache slot empirically established as (u, L+1)
K=8 splice measured at 55% fewer layer passes than eight full perturbed prefills
action_space.normalization: per-position residual RMS at the writable boundary
action_space.random_axes_gram_match: random control is regenerated non-discretionarily from fixed domain + SHA256(structured tensor), then Gram-matched exactly
action_space.alpha_selection_rule_note: alpha_star = largest magnitude satisfying the frozen coherence criterion; alpha_secondary = immediately smaller passing grid value; if only one passes, it becomes alpha_star and the secondary arm is omitted. Enforced by gate G15.

structured_axes.selection: one canonical axis per geometry the programme already separated; NOT a divergence contest

d1_readable_process_quality.construction: leakage-clean locus-native L3_24 process-quality readout; corrected source-item-disjoint training material; fit at L3_24 only; standardized/PCA coefficients mapped back to raw 2048-d residual space; unit RMS

d2_empirical_outcome.construction: unitRMS(mu_correct - mu_incorrect) at L3_24, task-balanced class means, first singular vector of the task-bootstrap mean-difference ensemble; frozen pre-O1 data only

d3_writable_transport.construction: leading principal direction of the centered exact-protocol S1/S3 injection-delta bundle at L3_24; from the existing delta bundle, never from O1 outcomes

d4_learned_actuator.construction: run both independently trained adapters on a sealed pre-O1 reference set; capture induced L3_24 residual update at the final prompt position; leading PC each; sign-align; require cosine >= 0.90; average; unit RMS
d4_learned_actuator.caveat: the published 0.951 is between adapter PROXY directions, not between leading PCs of induced L3_24 updates. A reconstruction below 0.90 is evidence about the extraction method, not necessarily about adapter disagreement. Pre-declare which it is before sealing.

structured_axes.duplicate_rule: |cos(d_i,d_j)| < 0.98 only. The blanket 0.8 cap is REMOVED: readable and outcome directions are expected to overlap, and excluding one because their angle is scientifically non-random would destroy the design's interpretation. The Gram-matched random bank controls for correlation.
structured_axes.no_cross_locus_transport: every axis must exist or be reconstructed at exactly L3_24 in raw 2048-d residual coordinates. No L4 vector reused at L3, no concatenated 24/36/47 tap weights, no layer-36 projection, no pooled four-loop direction, no silent substitution. If any of the four cannot be produced from frozen pre-O1 artifacts, DO NOT SEAL; run a bounded axis-reconstruction preflight.

alpha_calibration.note: G15 enforces alpha_star == max(passing_alphas) under rule 'largest_passing', and alpha_secondary == max{a in passing : a < alpha_star}. Without this object the gate can only check adjacency.
alpha_calibration.partition_rule: passing and failing alphas must be disjoint and together equal the swept grid; every failing alpha needs a reason; no passing alpha may carry one; alpha_secondary must be in passing_alphas and is null when only one magnitude passes

criteria: no NaN or Inf in logits
well-formed rate within margin of matched baseline
coherence_gate.well_formed_criterion: see difficulty_strata: absolute floor 0.85 per stratum AND noninferiority margin -0.05 on the lower one-sided 95% bound. One margin, not two.

bank.seed_matrix_scheme: seed = uint64_be(SHA256("O1_STREAM_SEED_V1\0" || uint64_be(master_seed) || uint32_be(len(UTF8(task_id))) || UTF8(task_id) || uint8(stream_index))[0:8]); identical across arms at each stream index; implemented by build_seed_matrix.py and enforced by G16
bank.stream_assignment_rule: stream(a,g) = (a + r_g) mod 8; a = 2*(direction_id-1) + (0 if sign=+1 else 1); r_g = task rank within its stratum in sealed manifest order, mod 8. Same schedule for the random bank. Enforced by gate G13.

power.q_disc_measured_under: CRN-paired eight-stream bank geometry; BANK-level, not row-level
power.test: two-sided exact McNemar, directional rejection counted; this is exactly the POSITIVE_HEADROOM rejection criterion
power.method: exact finite sum over N_disc ~ Bin(G,q), N10|n ~ Bin(n,pi); no simulation
power.cross_check: G17 asserts G_power == required_G(q_disc_upper, delta_target) and G_confirm == min(G_power, G_max)
power.G_confirm_note: numeric freeze slot; G17 additionally recomputes min(G_power, G_max) and rejects disagreement

budget.on_hardware_interruption: resume only the missing sealed task shards with the same hashes and streams; no replacement tasks; analyze only at 100% completion

zero_alpha_null.rationale: on a documented bit-exact path, identical tokens must imply identical deterministic downstream metadata; otherwise a parser, stopping-rule or verifier defect hides behind the same final binary reward

endpoints.primary: H_reach = mean_g[ max_i R(structured, alpha_star)_gi - max_i R(baseline)_gi ], both strata pooled, malformed = 0
endpoints.primary_inference: exact two-sided McNemar with directional sign for POSITIVE_HEADROOM/HARMFUL; paired task bootstrap 10000 draws is descriptive; one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson bound carries practical-equivalence verdict
endpoints.multiplicity: no secondary cell may replace a null primary as a headline
endpoints.one_sided_bound_method: exact Clopper-Pearson on the discordant cell (bootstrap is degenerate at n_disc = 0)

malformed_convention.rule: R = well_formed AND verifier_correct; malformed scores 0 inside max_i
malformed_convention.deliberate_reversal_of: the pre-answer AUROC convention, which excludes malformed from the label set
malformed_convention.rationale: O1 asks whether the intervention produces a usable correct answer; a continuation that never commits is a failure of the intervention, not an unlabelable case

prohibitions: no change to the task slice after the first confirmatory outcome is read
no change to alpha_star, the axes, or the bank geometry after sealing
no change to G after sealing
no re-selection of strata using confirmatory outcomes
no secondary endpoint opened before the primary is opened and hashed
no subtraction of H_0 from the primary
no filtering of rows on first_divergence

cohorts.confirmatory_task_manifest_format: JSONL per line: task_id, stratum, generator_setting_id, sealed_rank_within_stratum, task_content_sha256. Ranks must be a permutation of 0..n_s-1 within each stratum; task IDs and content hashes unique within a cohort; content hashes disjoint ACROSS cohorts.
cohorts.seed_matrix_format: {"<task_id>": {"<stream_index>": <seed>}} with explicit per-stream seeds; empty placeholders are rejected by G16
cohorts.record_content_binding: every record carries task_content_sha256 and must match the sealed value for its task_id

schema_additions.downstream_delta_rms: REQUIRED non-null on every intervention arm, null on baseline. Measured downstream residual change vs the paired baseline. Without it a null cannot be decomposed into 'the delta never propagated' vs 'it propagated and changed nothing useful'. Zero-alpha rows must be exactly 0.
schema_additions.run_provenance_sha256: REQUIRED on every confirmatory row; must equal the committed RUN_PROVENANCE.json hash (G21).
schema_additions.pregeneration_seal_sha256: REQUIRED on every confirmatory row; must equal PREGENERATION_SEAL.json hash (G21).
schema_additions.generator_setting_id: REQUIRED on every confirmatory row; must equal the sealed task-manifest setting (G11).
schema_additions.calibration_precommit_sha256: REQUIRED on every calibration row and in CALIBRATION_METADATA.json; must equal CALIBRATION_PRECOMMIT.json.

transport.measurement_definition: rho = RMS(h_int[L4,47, final non-padding prompt position] - h_base[same]) / RMS(delta_in). Scale-free ratio: does not conflate residual magnitude with alpha. Measured before any stochastic decoding.
transport.norm_convention: RMS over the 2048 hidden coordinates at the frozen measurement locus
transport.dead_threshold_note: an interpretation threshold, not a numerical tolerance: it defines when a nonzero intervention counts as having failed to propagate. Frozen here, not left as a function default.

axis_artifact.verified_by: verify_axis_artifact.py (A0-A17); assurance reported as STRUCTURALLY VERIFIED vs ATTESTED ONLY
axis_artifact.random_bank_construction: s_random = SHA256('O1-v1.5-fixed-random-domain' || SHA256(D)); canonical QR; C=D D^T=L L^T; R=L U^T. No master seed is accepted or attested.
axis_artifact.provenance_note: 'same locus' does not describe provenance. A direction learned from pooled completed-candidate states and injected at the final prompt position is a deliberate cross-phase transfer; it may be worthwhile but must not be described as though trained at that prompt-state distribution.

runtime_provenance.written: before PREGENERATION_SEAL.json and before the confirmatory records file exists
runtime_provenance.resolved_generation_config: exact recursive copy of code/model/generator/difficulty_strata/decoding/action_space/bank/cohorts/artifact_hashes/transport/zero_alpha_null from the sealed manifest
runtime_provenance.note: G14 compares the complete canonical object recursively and rejects missing, changed, or extra configuration surfaces.

calibration.analysis: calibration_analysis.py recomputes difficulty settings, coherence, alpha selection, discordance bound, throughput, arm drop plan, G_power/G_max/G_confirm; run_primary recomputes and compares byte-for-byte
calibration.precommit_note: Created before any calibration continuation exists; binds the calibration task manifest, exact calibration-generation design, real runtime artifact hashes, generation-module hash, and repository diff.

pregeneration_seal.created_by: pregeneration_seal.py before the confirmatory records path exists or contains bytes
pregeneration_seal.consumed_by: run_primary before provenance, calibration, record, zero-alpha, or endpoint analysis
pregeneration_seal.chronology_note: A remote Git commit or timestamp strengthens chronology; the local executable minimum is that run_primary requires and verifies this independent pre-generation commitment.
